title: Bedz King Twin Over Full Stairway Bunk Bed
text:
Bedz King Twin Over Full Stairway Bunk Bed. UPDATED REVIEW BELOW... Purchased two sets and sent to my daughter in Arizona. She recently moved into a new house and my grandsons now have their own rooms, thus the two sets. My daughter and son-in-law report that the wood looks very, very high quality and they arrived in good condition. They were very well packed. It did take them the better part of an afternoon to put the first set together, but they feel as though the second set will possibly take a little less time as they are now "experienced" in having already done the first set. I will include pics when they provide them. I will say that my 5 year old grandson was SOOOOO excited he could hardly contain himself. My daughter says that it is SO nice to have the drawers and not a ladder. I also purchased some memory foam mattresses to use with these sets (8" and my daughter reports they fit perfectly in terms of thickness). We chose these beds because there wasn't any particle board and while I haven't seen them yet in person, I think they will last as long as the boys will want to be in them. I will update with any information that might be useful. Further, I do NOT receive compensation of ANY kind for my reviews.
UPDATE: 8/2/2016..... I have now seen the beds in person. And all I can say is WOW. Honestly. These beds are the same price as the really flimsy metal beds in local stores here in Arizona... and yet THESE beds are just unbelievable quality FULL wood. The grain is simply beautiful and rich. I am SOOOO pleased with my purchase. I would definitely recommend them. My daughter reports they arrived in excellent condition via a special shipper. My daughter did say that it helps to have two people to finish the beds. While one person can easily assemble the stairs, but putting the frame together with the stairs really requires a second person. She did not feel the need to reinforce the bottom slats as another reviewer stated - but everyone should make their own decision on that. As the boys get bigger she made add slats. She also feels that they are very high quality and is very, very happy with them. My grandsons are also VERY happy with them. I purchased 8" memory foam mattresses (made in the usa) to go on the beds and that really completes the quality. These beds will last every minute as long as they boys want them and then be good enough to share along in the family. Again, I do NOT receive compensation of any kind for my reviews. And I would recommend this particular bed and seller all day long.

product_metadata.title: Bedz King Twin Over Full Stairway Bunk Bed, Expresso
features: Stairway Twin over Full Bunk Bed
Built-in Stairway instead of ladder for easy access to the top bunk
description: Solid Wood Expresso Finish Stairway Twin over Full Brazilian Pine Bunk Beds or can be separated into one twin and one full size bed - 4 drawers built into Stairway for added storage - This bunk bed model has been tested by an independent laboratory - Finish is child-safe and lead free - All wood is fully sanded and protected with a clean smooth coating to prevent cracks and splinters - Solid Brazilian Pine no particle board - Total Dimensions are approx. 69 1/2 high x 104 wide x 60 Inch deep - Bottom bunk is approx. 11 Inch off the floor - Space between bottom bunk slats and top bunk slats (excluding the mattress) is approx. 38 Inch - Internal measurements of the Drawers are approx. 17 3/4 Inch wide x 15 Inch deep x 10 Inch high - Set includes (4) Side Rails (2) Head Boards (1) Foot Board (26) Wood Slats (1) Center Support for Full Bunk (4) Guard Rails on both sides for the top twin bunk (4) Drawers (4) Step Stairway access - Hardware and instructions included.
